create_AnnJsonGenerator: create an AnnJsonGenerator instance from a detectron2 config and dataset list to generate COCO-format annotation JSON
run_AnnJsonGenerator_process: run the AnnJsonGenerator process method on model inputs and outputs to collect predictions
run_AnnJsonGenerator_evaluate: run the AnnJsonGenerator evaluate method to synchronize distributed predictions and write annotation JSON
build_instances_to_coco_ann_json: build COCO annotation entries from Detectron2 instances with predicted boxes and classes for a given image
test_base2novel: test the base2novel mapping method to convert base part IDs to novel part IDs for a given object category
